name: SOICT 2026
full_name: The 15th International Symposium on Information and Communication Technology
summarization: SOICT 2026 is an international symposium covering significant research areas such as AI Foundations and Big Data, Networking and Communication Technologies, Multimedia Processing, AI Applications, Generative AI, Applied Operations Research and Optimization, and Recent Advances in Cyber Security. It aims to provide an academic forum for researchers and graduate students to share their latest research findings, identify future computer science challenges, and feature tutorials and keynotes by world-class speakers.

name: RIVF 2026
full_name: The 20th International Conference on Computing and Communication Technologies
summarization: RIVF is a major scientific event for researchers, professionals, and students in the field of Computing and Communication Technologies. The 2026 edition will take place in Hanoi, Vietnam, featuring paper presentations, tutorials, keynote speakers, and special sessions.

name: AICON 2026
full_name: 6th EAI International Conference on Artificial Intelligence for Communications and Networks
summarization: The 6th EAI International Conference on Artificial Intelligence for Communications and Networks (EAI AICON 2026) focuses on artificial intelligence methods and systems that directly advance communication technologies, network infrastructures, and connected autonomous systems. It brings together researchers, engineers, and practitioners working at the intersection of AI, communications, and networking, targeting AI-enabled design, optimization, operation, and protection of wireless, mobile, satellite, optical, Internet of Things, and cloud-edge networks including 5G and 6G systems.
location: Phu Quoc Island, An Giang, Vietnam

name: AMI 2026
full_name: The 1st International Conference on Autonomous Machine Intelligence
summarization: The International Conference on Autonomous Machine Intelligence (AMI 2026) is an international forum dedicated to the study of autonomous, self-supervised, and predictive learning systems. The conference brings together researchers and practitioners to advance the foundations and applications of next-generation intelligent systems capable of learning and acting with minimal human supervision, focusing on paradigms such as world models, energy-based models, and joint embedding predictive architectures.

name: ICEBA 2026
full_name: The 12th International Conference on E-Business and Applications
summarization: ICEBA 2026 provides an international forum for presenting original research results and exchanging practical development experiences in e-business and applications. The conference focuses on themes such as intelligent tech for enterprise digital transformation, innovative cross-border e-business service models, and sustainable cross-border e-business development. It brings together researchers, application developers, and practitioners to share insights on how e-business empowers enterprise growth and innovation.

name: REV-ECIT 2026
full_name: Hội nghị Quốc gia lần thứ XXIX về Điện tử, Truyền thông và Công nghệ Thông tin
summarization: The 29th National Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (REV-ECIT 2026) is an annual national scientific conference organized by the Radio-Electronics Association of Vietnam (REV). The conference covers topics across electronics, communications, and information technology, with a special focus on national strategic technologies.

name: AICI 2027
full_name: The Eighth International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Computational Intelligence
summarization: The International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Computational Intelligence brings together researchers to present and discuss theoretical and applied research problems in artificial intelligence, computational intelligence, and related soft computing techniques with biomedical and related applications. The event serves as an opportunity to foster research collaborations among leading scientists, scholars, and practitioners worldwide. The 2027 edition is held in a hybrid format with both online and offline participation options.
location: Thang Long University, Nghiem Xuan Yem Road, Dinh Cong District, Hanoi

name: ICIIT 2027
full_name: 2027 12th International Conference on Intelligent Information Technology
summarization: The 2027 12th International Conference on Intelligent Information Technology (ICIIT 2027) serves as an interactive forum for presentation and discussion on intelligent information technology and related fields. It brings together researchers and professionals from around the world to establish global ties and explore career opportunities. The event features peer-reviewed paper presentations, keynote speeches, and publication opportunities in conference proceedings and associated journals.

name: ICCIES 2027
full_name: The 3rd International Conference on Computational Intelligence in Engineering Science
summarization: ICCIES 2027 is an annual international academic forum that provides a platform for researchers, academics, and professionals to exchange knowledge, share experiences, and explore innovations, recent advances, and emerging trends in intelligent computing across a broad range of engineering disciplines, including Information Technology, Electrical and Electronics Engineering, Mechatronics, and the Internet of Things ecosystem. The conference fosters international collaboration, disseminating research findings, and bringing together researchers from universities, research institutions, and industry.
location: Ton Duc Thang University, Ho Chi Minh City

name: AAMAS 2027
full_name: The 26th International Conference on Autonomous Agents and Multiagent Systems
summarization: AAMAS 2027 is the flagship conference of the International Foundation for Autonomous Agents and Multiagent Systems (IFAAMAS), bringing together researchers and practitioners in all areas of agent and agentic technology. It provides an internationally renowned high-profile forum for publishing and discovering the latest developments in autonomous agents and multiagent systems.

full_name: The 25th ACM International Conference on Mobile Systems, Applications, and Services
summarization: ACM MobiSys 2027 aims to showcase innovative and impactful research on the design, implementation, usage, and evaluation of mobile computing and wireless systems, applications, and services. It is sponsored by ACM SIGMOBILE and builds on the success of the previous twenty-four ACM MobiSys conferences.

name: EASE 2027
full_name: International Conference on Evaluation and Assessment in Software Engineering
summarization: EASE 2027 is an internationally leading venue for academics and practitioners to present and discuss their research on evidence-based software engineering and its implications for software practice. The conference welcomes high-quality submissions across various tracks including full research papers, short papers, industry papers, posters, and doctoral symposiums.

name: WCST 2026
full_name: 4th World Conference on Smart Tourism
summarization: The 4th World Conference on Smart Tourism focuses on synergizing industry and academia, specifically harnessing AI for transformative tourism and hospitality in the Global South. It brings together researchers, practitioners, and students to discuss advancements in smart tourism.

name: TSE 2026
full_name: 2026 International Conference on Advanced Technologies for Search & Rescue and Emergency Response Systems
summarization: The 2026 International Conference on Advanced Technologies for Search & Rescue and Emergency Response Systems (TSE 2026) provides a forum for exchanging ideas, discussing research results, and presenting cutting-edge innovations at the intersection of science, technology, and emergency management. The event brings together global researchers, engineers, practitioners, policymakers, and industry leaders to address challenges in search and rescue operations and emergency response.

name: CSoNet 2026
full_name: The 15th International Conference on Computational Science and Network Intelligence
summarization: CSoNet 2026 is an interdisciplinary conference focusing on computational science, network intelligence, and data-driven methods. It covers research areas such as network algorithms, graph neural networks, scientific computing, artificial intelligence, and applications in complex systems. The event aims to bring together researchers, engineers, and practitioners to exchange theoretical foundations, methodological advances, and real-world applications.

name: ICTA 2026
full_name: International Conference on Advances in Information and Communication Technology
summarization: The International Conference on Advances in Information and Communication Technology (ICTA 2026) provides an international forum for researchers, academics, industry experts, and practitioners to exchange innovative ideas and research findings in ICT. The conference focuses on the rapid convergence of artificial intelligence, advanced ICT infrastructure, and cybersecurity technologies transforming modern societies, smart cities, and digital industries. It aims to bridge theoretical research with real-world applications and foster interdisciplinary collaboration across areas such as intelligent data systems, multimedia technologies, smart infrastructure, and robotics.

name: ICDSAIA 2026
full_name: International Conference on Data Science, Artificial Intelligence and Applications
summarization: The 2nd International Conference on Data Science, AI and Applications (ICDSAIA 2026) brings together experts, researchers, and innovators from around the world to explore the latest advancements in Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, and their real-world applications. Attendees will engage with thought leaders, collaborate with peers, and discover groundbreaking solutions shaping the future of these fields.
location: Phan Tay Nhac Street, Xuan Phuong Ward, Hanoi

name: AIEI 2027
full_name: International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Energy and Infrastructure
summarization: AIEI 2027 is the second edition of the international conference dedicated to artificial intelligence for energy systems, resilient infrastructure, and sustainable cities. Hosted by COSARI at Van Lang University, the event brings together researchers, academics, engineers, and industry professionals to discuss smart energy, infrastructure, AI and data, and reliability. It provides a platform for sharing recent results, fostering collaborations, and exploring responsible, reliable, and impactful AI solutions.

name: IEEE SMC 2027
full_name: 2027 IEEE International Conference on Systems, Man, and Cybernetics
summarization: The 2027 IEEE International Conference on Systems, Man, and Cybernetics (IEEE SMC 2027) focuses on systems science and engineering, cybernetics, and human-machine systems under the theme "Human-AI Symbiosis: Engineering Intelligent, Autonomous, and Sustainable Futures". It provides an international forum for researchers, engineers, and academics to discuss challenges and design intelligent systems prioritizing human well-being and societal sustainability.
location: Sheraton Saigon Grand Opera Hotel, Ho Chi Minh City

name: FJCAI 2027
full_name: FJCAI 2027
summarization: Hội thảo khoa học về Trí tuệ nhân tạo (FJCAI 2027) là diễn đàn học thuật toàn quốc thường niên quy tụ các nhà nghiên cứu, giảng viên, nghiên cứu sinh, sinh viên và chuyên gia trong lĩnh vực Trí tuệ nhân tạo (AI) nhằm trao đổi, chia sẻ các kết quả nghiên cứu mới nhất, xu hướng phát triển, thách thức và ứng dụng của AI.
location: Trường Đại học Công nghệ Thông tin và Truyền thông Việt - Hàn (VKU), Đà Nẵng

name: IEEE NICE–TEAS ASIA 2026
full_name: 4th IEEE Networking International Conference on Emerging Trends in Expert Systems, Applications & Security, ASIA
summarization: The conference focuses on emerging trends in expert systems, applications, and security, with proceedings published by IEEE and papers submitted for possible inclusion in IEEE Xplore.

name: ENASE 2027
full_name: ENASE 2027 - Evaluation of Novel Approaches to Software Engineering
summarization: The mission of ENASE is to be a prime international forum to discuss and publish research findings and IT industry experiences with relation to novel approaches to software engineering. The conference acknowledges evolution in systems and software thinking due to contemporary shifts of computing paradigms to AI-assisted coding, low-code/no-code platforms, cloud and edge computing, security and DevSecOps, IoT integration, and sustainable engineering.

name: GCHRCLI 2027
full_name: Global Conference on Human Rights, Cybersecurity & Legal Innovation
summarization: The Global Conference on Human Rights, Cybersecurity & Legal Innovation (GCHRCLI) provides an international platform for academicians, researchers, engineers, industrial participants, and students to share research findings and experiences. The event focuses on topics related to human rights, cybersecurity, and legal innovation, offering opportunities for networking, research collaboration, and publication in Scopus-indexed and reputed journals.

name: ICCSS 2027
full_name: 2027 10th International Conference on Circuits, Systems and Simulation
summarization: The 2027 10th International Conference on Circuits, Systems and Simulation (ICCSS) provides a platform for scientists, engineers, technicians, and graduate students to share research experiences and ideas in circuits, systems, and simulation. The conference invites submissions of full papers or abstracts, which undergo peer review and are published in the conference proceedings upon acceptance.

name: 8th IEEE AICAS 2026
full_name: 2026 IEEE 8th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence Circuits and Systems (AICAS 2026)
summarization: The 8th IEEE International Conference on Artificial Intelligence Circuits and Systems (AICAS 2026) is a flagship event focusing on cutting-edge research in artificial intelligence circuits and systems. The conference is organized by IEEE CASS Vietnam and IEEE CASS China, and hosted by Vietnam National University, Hanoi. It brings together researchers and professionals to discuss topics such as in-memory computing, hardware/software co-design, neuromorphic circuits, and emerging AI applications.

name: REV 2026
full_name: Hội nghị Quốc gia lần thứ XXIX về Điện tử, Truyền thông và Công nghệ Thông tin
summarization: REV-ECIT 2026 is the 29th National Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology organized by the Radio-Electronics Association of Vietnam (REV). The conference covers topics across electronics, communications, and information technology, with a special focus on national strategic technologies to shape Vietnam's digital future.

name: ICE 2027
full_name: ICE IEEE/ITMC
summarization: The ICE IEEE/ITMC international event invites high quality papers to be presented, contributing to substantial, original and previously unpublished research in the topics of engineering, technology, innovation, and entrepreneurship.

name: ICERA 2026
full_name: 9th International Conference on Engineering Research and Applications
summarization: The 9th International Conference on Engineering Research and Applications (ICERA 2026) is an international forum focusing on recent and relevant research, theories, and practices in engineering research, applications, and economics. It welcomes submissions across various tracks including mechanical engineering, materials, mechatronics, automotive, electrical and electronics engineering, information and communication technology, and economics.

summarization: The 3rd EAI International Conference on Responsible Artificial Intelligence and Data Science (EAI RAIDS 2027) serves as an international forum for the exchange of research and ideas regarding Responsible & Trustworthy AI, Data Science, Machine Learning, AI applications, transparency, fairness, and privacy. It invites researchers, scholars, and experts to present novel contributions and ongoing research across various domains such as healthcare, smart manufacturing, fintech, and smart cities.

name: ICETAI 2027
full_name: International Conference on Educational Technology and Artificial Intelligence
summarization: ICETAI 2027 focuses on trustworthy agentic AI in education, exploring topics such as multi-agent systems, explainable AI for learning and assessment, retrieval-augmented generation, and human-AI collaboration. The event serves as a platform for researchers and practitioners to discuss intelligent tutoring systems, automated assessment, learning analytics, and the digital transformation of education in the AI era.

name: EAI INISCOM 2027
full_name: 13th EAI International Conference on Industrial Networks and Intelligent Systems
summarization: The 13th EAI International Conference on Industrial Networks and Intelligent Systems (EAI INISCOM 2027) brings together researchers, practitioners, and industry experts to explore the frontier of the 6G era. The conference focuses on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence, Digital Twins, and Quantum Computing, and their transition from cutting-edge technologies to real-world applications in industrial networks and intelligent systems.

name: GSETS 2027
full_name: The 3rd International Conference on Green Solutions and Emerging Technologies for Sustainability
summarization: GSETS 2027 is an international scientific event showcasing advanced achievements in Material Science, Green Technology, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, and emerging technologies aimed at achieving the United Nations' Sustainable Development Goals. It focuses on specialized topics including Advanced Materials and Green Manufacturing, Solutions and Technologies for Sustainable Development, Data Science and Artificial Intelligence for Sustainable Development, and Health Sciences for Sustainable Development. The conference aims to strengthen collaboration and research exchanges among Vietnamese and international universities, share research experiences, and create opportunities for scientific and technological cooperation.
